name: Meyer
source: Meyer Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, group column: consolidated statement of profit or loss page 17 and financial summary group page 57. Every populated FY2025 and FY2024 row ties: Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit, Gross Profit less net operating cost equals Operating Profit, Operating Profit plus Net Finance Costs equals Profit Before Tax, and Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. Operating expenses, operating profit and net finance costs for FY2023 to FY2021 are withheld because the issuer summary prints no operating lines and the stored figures did not tie to the printed profit before tax.
